caption: The drawing depicts a single object rendered in shades of dark brown and bronze against a plain cream or off-white background. The object appears to be a three-dimensional, metal trivet with an ornate, arched top and a single, wide handle splitting into two prong-like feet at its base. Within the arch, there is an oval medallion featuring the raised relief portrait of a man with prominent cheekbones, a ruffled neckpiece, and period-style clothing suggesting historical significance. The arch and the supporting handle have simple decorative grooves. Handwritten text in neat script is visible toward the lower right of the page, reading "C.W. DAWSON" and "Ed Gardner."
title: Trivet
